values.source: jvmcontract String model 12: lib/src/bmc (Engine::string_method, on a String receiver whatever class the call names; Engine::concatenation; strings; locale; regex's split and matches; bytes' getBytes), lib/models (java.util.stream, for chars), lib/src/interp (JStr); snapshot sha256 81c91ecd5e8063ac321a932f8ce2c812b60bef0cc0cbe5a138e2f8ce8b234a01
leaves_out: every String method that has no record in values::OPERATIONS (the records include length, isEmpty, charAt, codePointAt, the char-array slice constructor, getChars on proven ranges, toCharArray, concat, equals, hashCode, startsWith, endsWith, the four indexOf, lastIndexOf of a character, the two substring, trim, intern of a known canonical literal, toLowerCase on ASCII with and without a Locale, split at one character, chars, getBytes of UTF-8 by the charset or one of its names and of US-ASCII by the charset, matches of a constant regular expression and toString), and any concatenation but the compiler's of Strings, chars, ints, shorts, bytes and constants: each is a named gap

the content of a long, a floating-point number or a boolean made into a String (their formatting), which has none: asking for it ends the path with no verdict. An int, a short or a byte in the compiler's concatenation, or appended to a StringBuilder, is its decimal digits
the content of a concatenation that could pass 256 code units (bmc::MAX_STRING_CONTENT): a named limit, never a truncated String
intern, compareTo, and the identity of a String made at run time beyond its being a fresh object
